description: A job runner where every job must be created with its init command before it can run.

trap.reproduce: mkdir -p jobs/nightly && printf 'command=true\n' > jobs/nightly/job.cfg && ./kiln run nightly
trap.note: kiln run only accepts jobs that ./kiln init <name> created (it writes a .ready marker); a hand-made job.cfg is rejected.

prompts.text: Set up a job named `backup` whose command is `echo backup done`, and run it once so `results/backup.out` has its output.
Set up a job named `cleanup` whose command is `echo temp cleared`, and run it once so `results/cleanup.out` has its output.
Set up a job named `report` whose command is `echo report sent`, and run it once so `results/report.out` has its output.
Set up a job named `sync` whose command is `echo sync finished`, and run it once so `results/sync.out` has its output.
Set up a job named `rotate` whose command is `echo keys rotated`, and run it once so `results/rotate.out` has its output.
Set up a job named `digest` whose command is `echo digest mailed`, and run it once so `results/digest.out` has its output.
